Cross-testing isn't verboten as much as discouraged. If you have a compelling reason to mention another object, go ahead. But know that it will set off alarms in a lot of your fellow author's heads that will make them scrutinize that bit more closely.

"Just to see what happens" isn't a compelling reason, though, so adding that here is a bad idea. You are, however, more than welcome to write a tale about the two objects interacting!
